decision.explanation: The sources present conflicting descriptions of the student body at St. Michael Academy. D1S1 describes it as 'an all-boys Roman Catholic high school,' supporting 'all-boys.' D3S1 describes it as 'a co-ed private, catholic, college preparatory school,' supporting 'co-ed.' D4S3 describes it as 'an all-girls, private, Roman Catholic high school,' supporting 'female.' These are distinct claims about the same entity, and since they are not mutually exclusive (e.g., could refer to different campuses or historical periods), all are retained as valid candidates.
